test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice with six faces is marked with six numbers 1, 2,3,4,5 and 6, respectively. It is rolled 2 times and lands on the positions shown below. Which number is on the opposite plane of 5?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7b524f6aedf7e19525b14e7a7ae6c4628919476a69cc8772be8c427961d81b1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dices, it is clear that 2, 4, 3, and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3b771e65d4071db519e4df0fcd93dbe98498fdefc18c610e9657a60b3d2d85d.png] 

Opposite pairs:

4 → 6

2 → 3

5 → 1

So, the opposite side of "5" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
